abstract: Classical Collatz cycle exclusions bound the Steiner circuit count $m$ and degrade linearly whenever an elementary valuation unit $1^r d$ ($r\geq 1$, $d\geq 2$) repeats $u$ times; even for two periodic stretches, prior bounds incur penalties in $r$ or $r+d$. We establish bounded-block polymer cycle exclusions that hold uniformly across unbounded climb lengths, terminal halvings, repetition multiplicities, and pure-descent lengths at three nested levels. First, in the $\{1,2\}$-valuation semigroup $\langle T_1,T_2\rangle$, every nontrivial cycle decomposes canonically into $M$ mixed polymer blocks $(\mathcal{A}_{r_s}^{u_s} B^{v_s})$ ($\mathcal{A}_r=T_2\circ T_1^r$, $B=T_2$). Combining modulo-$6$ centered conjugation, an exact $T_1$-budget identity, multi-trough dynamic programming, and $2{,}600$ certified continued-fraction partial quotients of $\log_2 3$ ($q_{2597}>2^{4392}$) with Rhin’s irrationality measure excludes $1\leq M\leq 220$ unconditionally under the $\{1,2\}$-cycle floor $x_{\min}>2^{74}$ [7] ($M\leq 207$ under $x_{\min}>2^{71}$ [6]; $M\leq 28$ from direct replay below $2\cdot 10^6$). Second, for uniform-$r$ polymer-pin cycles sharing one parameter $r\geq 1$, exact ratio monotonicity $\gamma_r\Delta_{r+1}-\gamma_{r+1}\Delta_r=6^r>0$ and a two-regime continued-fraction and Rhin split exclude $r\geq 40, M\leq 260$ and $r\geq 44, M\leq 300$ analytically with zero external floor, yielding $M\leq 260$ across every $r\geq 1$ (while specialized $r=1$ dimer bounds [12] remain stronger at $r=1$). Third, across arbitrary Collatz valuations $e_i\geq 1$, contracting units ($2^{r+d}>3^{r+1}$) satisfy $x_*/(2^{r+1}-1)\leq 19/35$, and global excess-halving conservation excludes $1\leq M_{\mathrm{poly}}\leq 21$ under $x_{\min}>2^{71}$. All proofs and outward-rounded rational-interval certificates use zero floating-point arithmetic. Higher polymer counts ($M\geq 221$ in $\langle T_1,T_2\rangle$, $M_{\mathrm{poly}}\geq 22$ generally) and divergent trajectories remain open.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Completely rebuilt and expanded the rejected manuscript GjRQirrNGjWBpKoU from first principles, resolving every mathematical and presentation issue identified in the referee report: (1) Fixed the infinite-tail proof completely (Referee Points 1 & 2): eliminated the invalid C_{30,70}(208) <= 1.695e7 envelope and downward Tarski heuristic; proved exact ratio monotonicity gamma_r * Delta_{r+1} - gamma_{r+1} * Delta_r = 6^r > 0 so gamma_r / Delta_r <= gamma_{R_0} / Delta_{R_0} holds strictly without dropping the excess over 1/3; enclosed c_* = ln(3)*ln(3/2)/ln(4/3) in outward-rounded 200-bit RatInterval arithmetic; substituted r < (X_1 + ln 3)/c_* directly into the linear K_odd envelope A_tail * X_1 + B_tail (Proposition 5.2); and paired 2,600 certified continued-fraction terms of log_2(3) (q_{2597} > 2^{4392}, Lemma 3.1) below q_{2597} with Simons-de Weger / Rhin above q_{2597} to close all r >= 40 up to M <= 260 (and r >= 44 up to M <= 300) with zero external floor, overlapped by finite interval verification across 1 <= r <= 42. (2) Unified all-r uniform polymers (Theorem 2, M <= 260) with two broader theorems resolving arbitrary mixed-polymer cycles in <T_1, T_2> up to M <= 220 across unbounded r_s, u_s, v_s (Theorem 1) and generalized polymers across arbitrary unrestricted Collatz valuations e_i >= 1 up to M_poly <= 21 with sharp contracting fixed-point bound x_*/(2^{r+1}-1) <= 19/35 (Theorem 3). (3) Rebuilt the entire verification stack (code/collatz_cert_lib.py and code/verify_unified_polymers.py) with zero floating-point literals, zero float conversions, and zero math/decimal imports, cleanly separating algebraic/orbit checks (Suite A) from outward-rounded rational interval certificates (Suites B1-B3), and rewrote the abstract and Section 1 in clear explanatory prose with explicit scope boundaries.
title: Uniform Cycle Exclusions for Mixed, All-$r$, and Unrestricted-Valuation Collatz Polymers
